name: rdm_favoriteissue
label: R&D Management Favorite Issue Table
description: The favoriteissue table belongs to the R&D management module and is used for related queries and report scenarios in R&D management.

fields.name: issue_id
fields.description: Issue ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: User association ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the issue_id, user_id fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_userid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the user_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
